title: exchange operation
description: Ion-exchange equilibrium on the props bench: the declared water contacts a resin at a declared dose and the op reports the exchanged composition, the resin loading and the pH. The `exchange {}` block accepts resin, resinDose and CEC and NOTHING else — the capacity nameplate lives in the resin's own record, and an unknown key refuses by name with the grammar. `pH solve;` asks for the proton balance to be solved rather than given.

analyticalTotals.title: Analytical totals
analyticalTotals.description: The water being softened: `{ Ca 84 mg/L; Na 363 mg/L; ... }`.

pH.title: pH
pH.description: A number to fix it, or the word `solve` to compute it from the network.

exchange.title: Resin contact
exchange.description: REQUIRED. `{ resin <name>; resinDose <v> <L/kg|kg/kg>; }` — resin and dose; `CEC` may override the record's capacity for a what-if.

equilibrate.title: Allowed precipitation
equilibrate.description: As in `speciate`: let the NAMED minerals precipitate to SI = 0.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
